'''Twon Ketee''' was a [[Poison|toxic]] [[swamp]] [[planet]] that was home to [[rathtar]]s.

==Description==
A [[planet]] covered in thick [[jungle]]s and [[swamp]]s, Twon Ketee was inhabited by [[rathtar]]s. Its [[atmosphere]] was [[Poison|toxic]], requiring a [[breath mask]].<ref name="Darth Maul 1" />

==History==
[[File:MaulVSRathtars-2017DarthMaul1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Maul hunted rathtars on Twon Ketee around 32 BBY]]
Prior to the [[Battle of Naboo|Battle]] of [[Naboo]], an [[Unidentified alien hunter|alien hunter]] was hired to lead a group of [[Hunting|hunters]] to the [[planet]], where they were all [[Death|killed]] by a [[rathtar]]. The [[Sith]] [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]] had also traveled to Twon Ketee, watching the hunters from afar. Once the rathtar had been drawn out into the open, Maul killed it with a [[vibro-ax]]. [[Gender|He]] killed several more of the creatures, attempting to sate his bloodlust for [[Jedi]].<ref name="Darth Maul 1" />

Twon Ketee was one of the locations marked on a [[First Order]] [[Holomap|holo-map]] retrieved by the [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] during his [[Mission on the Colossus platform|mission]] on the [[Colossus]].<ref name="The New Trooper">{{Resistance|The New Trooper}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{SeeAlso|Twon Ketee/LEGO}}
[[File:LegoTwonKetee.png|thumb|right|137px|LEGO Twon Ketee]]
Twon Ketee first appeared in the [[2016]] non-canonical game ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> It made its first [[canon]] appearance in the [[2017]] comic [[Darth Maul (2017) 1|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 1]], written by [[Cullen Bunn]] and illustrated by [[Luke Ross]].<ref name="Darth Maul 1" />
